reviewed_by: Claude review of exported browser headers
reason: exporter._credential_free blanked every key named headers regardless of shape, so the recorded request headers of BrowserInterceptItem and BrowserRepeaterTab (list[tuple[str, str]] fields) were written as null in every project bundle: captured browser evidence lost its headers, and the record no longer matched its own model. The helper's purpose is to strip machine-local auth bindings, which are dict-shaped; list-shaped headers are recorded traffic. The list case now keeps the (name, value) pairs and redacts values for credential-bearing names (authorization, proxy-authorization, cookie, set-cookie, x-api-key, x-auth-token, x-csrf-token, and any name containing token or secret); the dict case is unchanged. test_exporter gains a bundle round trip asserting the intercept's host header survives and its authorization and cookie values are redacted (null on main); the file's other cases cover manifests, blobs, events, snapshots and reference handling.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the remaining-core fallback for exporter.py) is the real-Core journey suite and does not export a project with intercept records; the Python test writes and reads the bundle directly. No full suites.
